source.title: Mapzen Terrain Tiles / SRTM N24E118
source.attribution: Mapzen; SRTM data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey
source.temporalScope: modern geographic elevation reference; not a 1949 terrain reconstruction

derivation.method: nearest-neighbour downsample from 1-arc-second HGT; sea mask is source elevation > 0 with 1-cell coastal closure; closed zero values use the lowest positive source neighbour
derivation.runtimeLandMask: V0.5 ignores this compatibility land array and uses the independent OpenStreetMap coastline mask.
